summary.text: Nick Wilson is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 82 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and a former public defender and assistant commonwealth attorney.

paragraphs.text: Nick Wilson graduated from Whitley County High School, earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Kentucky, and received a J.D. from the University of Alabama.
His career experience includes working as a public defender in McCreary County and as an assistant commonwealth attorney in Whitley and McCreary counties.
Wilson took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Regina Huff.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Judiciary Committee, the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee, and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee, and he is vice chair of the Committee on Families and Children.
